question: Should Discord Activity A2UI access be implemented as a Canvas/Discord plugin-owned, fail-closed launch capability instead of this root Gateway `canvasHost.activity` query-token bridge?
rationale: This choice changes a public Gateway auth boundary and config contract, and automation should not decide whether to accept unauthenticated/token-in-URL Activity access or revive root Canvas config after the Canvas plugin migration.

options.title: Move to plugin-owned fail-closed Activity access
options.body: Port the feature into `extensions/discord` and `extensions/canvas`, require a credential or launch context before any Gateway auth bypass, avoid URL secrets, and scope/bound Activity state.

options.title: Accept the root Gateway bridge
options.body: Maintain the current design only with explicit owner approval, security documentation, upgrade proof, and tests for token rotation, missing tokens, and Activity WebSocket auth.

options.title: Pause for the newer Activity PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/65205 as the replacement only after it becomes clean, proof-positive, and passes the same auth/config review.

recommendation.title: Move to plugin-owned fail-closed Activity access
recommendation.body: Port the feature into `extensions/discord` and `extensions/canvas`, require a credential or launch context before any Gateway auth bypass, avoid URL secrets, and scope/bound Activity state.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history makes steipete the strongest routing candidate for both Canvas plugin ownership and Discord component contract changes.
